entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The aware essence of a plane, which knows what happens on its surface, can be hurt by magic, and can manifest as avatars and elementals.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who has talked to the worldsouls of Zendikar and Amonkhet and struggled with those of Innistrad, Ravnica and Avishkar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose soul Nissa Revane can communicate with and whose elemental manifestation was Ashaya.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane whose soul suffered under a terrible curse and reacted with hostility to Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose worldsoul acted hostile to Nissa Revane, and where two plane-less worldsoul entities were encountered.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A heavily urbanized plane whose worldsoul posed difficulties to Nissa; the dryads of the Selesnya Conclave are believed to be in contact with its hidden worldsoul.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane then named Kaladesh, whose unfamiliar Aether cycle posed difficulties to Nissa; its soul might be represented by the Great Conduit.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose worldsoul has Progenitus as its avatar.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The avatar of the worldsoul of Alara.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane whose worldsoul is Gaea.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The worldsoul of Dominaria, who carries a hatred caused by the cataclysms inflicted on the plane.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: The maro-sorcerer of Argoth, who briefly became an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: A war on Dominaria during which Titania became an avatar of Gaea.

entities.name: Lady of Otaria
entities.description: According to dwarven myth, the daughter of Gaea and the fire-god Fiers.

entities.name: Fiers
entities.description: A fire-god in dwarven myth, father of the Lady of Otaria.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane with no known true worldsoul, where Valgavoth serves as the worldsoul.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Serves as Duskmourn's worldsoul despite not being a known true worldsoul.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A character who stated that speaking with Zacama was engaging with the soul of Ixalan itself.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: A being who may be the worldsoul of Ixalan or a manifestation of it.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane whose soul Zacama may be or manifest.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A structure that might represent the soul of Avishkar.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Referred to on a March of the Machine card as the soul of the warriors' world on Kaldheim, possibly the worldsoul of all its realms.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane of many realms whose worldsoul may be the World Tree.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The very first kami, as old as Kamigawa itself.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Offspring of O-Kagachi, called Soul of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane whose soul is tied to the kami O-Kagachi and Kyodai.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The embodiment of day and one of the twin worldsouls of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The embodiment of night and one of the twin worldsouls of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: A plane that shifts between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor under the control of its twin worldsouls.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: A recurring event on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor after whose final occurrence the twin worldsouls reemerged.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The worldsoul of Ravnica, believed to be in hiding and in contact with the dryads of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose dryads are believed to be in contact with the hidden worldsoul.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A Dominarian who collapsed Serra's Realm's worldsoul into the Weatherlight's powerstone core.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A plane whose worldsoul was collapsed by Urza into the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship whose powerstone core was given power to travel the planes by Serra's Realm's collapsed worldsoul.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon native to Dominaria considered a partial worldsoul of Tarkir because his draconic power influenced its mana.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose mana was heavily influenced by Ugin.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: The elemental manifestation of Zendikar's soul.

entities.name: Bog Entity
entities.description: A plane-less worldsoul entity encountered on Innistrad.

entities.name: Davriel's Entity
entities.description: A plane-less worldsoul entity encountered on Innistrad.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose cryptoliths made Innistrad's worldsoul difficult for Nissa.

events.summary: Nissa Revane contacts Amonkhet's soul and learns it suffers under a terrible curse; it reacts with hostility to her.
events.quote: It reacted with hostility to her.

events.summary: Titania briefly becomes an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War.
events.quote: briefly became an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War

events.summary: Innistrad's worldsoul acts hostile to Nissa Revane.
events.quote: Innistrad's worldsoul acted hostile to Nissa Revane.

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reemerge after the final Great Aurora to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.
events.quote: They reemerged after the final Great Aurora to control the Plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor .

events.summary: Urza collapses Serra's Realm's worldsoul into the Weatherlight's powerstone core, giving it the power to travel the planes.
events.quote: giving it enough power to travel the planes

relations.quote: Progenitus is the avatar of the worldsoul.
Gaea is the worldsoul of Dominaria .

relations.note: according to dwarven myth, daughter of Gaea
relations.quote: the Lady of Otaria is the daughter of Gaea and the fire-god Fiers
Valgavoth serves as the plane's worldsoul.
His offspring is Kyodai , Soul of Kamigawa

relations.note: considered a partial worldsoul of Tarkir
relations.quote: Ugin is considered a partial worldsoul of Tarkir
